subject: SIG-Plus: SCIM delta + authz sampling request and delivery plan
messages:
From: Laura Grant <security@veridianhealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Adam Mills <adam.mills@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG-Plus: SCIM delta + authz sampling request

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking this — Veridian is running a SIG-Plus review and we need a short set of artifacts focused on identity/provisioning and authorization. Please see the asks below (we attached our SIG-Plus questionnaire and a short checklist):

1) SCIM delta export covering the last 90 days (ndjson or CSV). We need attribute-level deltas (created/updated/deleted) and metadata (timestamp, actor).

2) SAML assertion samples: three recent successful assertions that show NameID, attributes, and audience. Redact PII if required but keep attribute names intact.

3) RBAC snapshot: role -> member mapping for human and service accounts, plus an export of role descriptions and role-owner assignment. If you have a CSV with columns (role, member, member_type, owner) that would be ideal.

4) Brief note (1 page) on how Redwood enforces least-privilege for service accounts and a short owner roster.

5) Anything you can share about SCIM reject/error rates over last 30 days (top 10 error types) would be helpful but not blocking.

Target delivery: Jun 11 (one week). Delivery via secure upload link (we flagged a place below) or SFTP — please confirm transfer method and whether you prefer to ship in phased artifacts.

Attachment: SIGPlus-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

Let me know if any of the asks are unclear or if you need a narrower scope.

Best,

Laura
Laura Grant
Director, Security Assurance
Veridian Health

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Laura Grant <security@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG-Plus: SCIM delta + authz sampling request

Laura — thanks for the clear list. We'll own this and can deliver on the Jun 11 target with a short phased plan. Internal owners below:

- SCIM delta export (90d): Neha Kapoor — will generate ndjson and a CSV sample, include actor/timestamp.
- SAML assertion samples & SSO context: Sean Gallagher — will pull assertion snippets and the corresponding authentication log context.
- RBAC snapshot & owner roster: I will collate role->member mappings and the service account notes.

Quick clarifying Qs:
- For the SAML samples, do you want full HTTP-POST payloads or stripped assertion-only XML? We can provide both, but we'll redact full NameIDs if you prefer (we can mark them with placeholders).
- For SCIM, are you okay with ndjson (newline delimited JSON) as the canonical export?

We plan to deliver three artifact bundles: (A) SCIM delta + top error types, (B) SAML assertion samples + authn logs, (C) RBAC snapshot + one-page least-privilege summary. If you prefer a single package we can tar/zip and upload to your secure location.

I've attached a quick workback (redwood-workback-plan.xlsx) with proposed delivery windows. If you can confirm the upload link and encryption requirements we'll schedule the exports for this afternoon.

Thanks — Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Manager, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-workback-plan.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Laura Grant <security@veridianhealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Adam Mills <adam.mills@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG-Plus: SCIM delta + authz sampling request

Thanks Aisha — that phased plan works. A couple of notes:

- For SAML samples, assertion-only XML is preferred (we want the <Assertion> blob). NameID can be redacted but leave attribute names/values (or replace sensitive values with placeholders).
- NDJSON is perfect for SCIM. Please include a README that documents the fields and the timestamp format.
- Delivery method: our secure transfer portal is preferred — please upload to: https://veridianhealth.securetransfer.example/upload/VER-1234 (use the project code VER-1234 in the comments). If you need SFTP credentials instead ping me and we'll provision.

We also accept GPG-encrypted tarballs if that's easier for you.

Finally — can you include a quick checksum (sha256) for any archive you upload?

I'll stand by for the SCIM sample this afternoon.

Laura

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Laura Grant <security@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG-Plus: SCIM delta + authz sampling request

Laura — confirmed. We'll do the following schedule and upload to your portal (VER-1234):

- Today (Jun 4, by 18:00 PT): SCIM delta 7-day sample + README + scim-delta-sample.ndjson (Neha).
- Jun 8: Full 90-day SCIM delta export (ndjson + csv slice) + top-10 error types (Neha).
- Jun 9: SAML assertion samples (3 assertions) + authn log snippets (Sean).
- Jun 11: RBAC snapshot, role-owner roster, and one-page least-privilege summary (Aisha).

We will redact personal identifiers per your guidance and provide sha256 checksums for each archive. If anything slips we will notify you and provide a partial deliverable through the portal so you can start review.

Thanks again — we’ll upload the SCIM sample this afternoon and reply here with the upload confirmation and checksum.

—Aisha
